name: google-workspace
description: Connects one Google account to Tovu with Google's own sign-in, then works with the Google files the person picks or Tovu creates (the drive.file permission, never the whole Drive). v1 ships Google Sheets: chat tools for spreadsheets and a form destination that appends submissions as rows. Products are turned on separately; turning one off stops its tools and deliveries without revoking the sign-in.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Sign in with Google once, then let Tovu work with the spreadsheets you choose or create.
